core_meaning.primary_meaning: Firdausi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Paradise”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firdausi corresponds to the Arabic form فردوسي (Arabic فردوس (firdaws) + nisba ending -ī). Its core sense is of paradise, heavenly. Firdausi is the nisba adjective of فردوس (firdaws) 'paradise' — 'heavenly, of paradise'. It is best known as the pen-name of the poet Abul-Qasem Ferdowsi (author of the Shahnameh), from which its currency derives. The source gloss 'paradise garden' is a fair paraphrase.

persian.name: فردوسی
persian.long_meaning: Firdausi (فردوسی) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن بهشتی، فردوسی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
